name: sakaime-video
description: Demo video for Sakaime: a Remotion composition over real footage of the running product.

scripts.studio: npm run sync && npm run data && remotion studio src/index.ts --port=3986
scripts.check: npm run data && npm run check:words && npm run check:numbers && npm run check:cues && npm run check:length
scripts.render: npm run sync && npm run check && remotion render src/index.ts Sakaime out/sakaime-demo.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=17 --pixel-format=yuv420p --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=192k --port=3987 && node scripts/check-length.mjs --video out/sakaime-demo.mp4
scripts.build:all: npm run ui && npm run footage && npm run snapshot && npm run data && npm run voice && npm run docs && npm run render && npm run render:captions && npm run frames
scripts.render:captions: npm run sync && npm run check && remotion render src/index.ts Sakaime out/sakaime-demo-captions.mp4 --props=./props/captions.json --codec=h264 --crf=17 --pixel-format=yuv420p --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=192k --port=3987 && node scripts/check-length.mjs --video out/sakaime-demo-captions.mp4
